Hi Ron

Can you navigate to settings > account name > folders From there you should see a list of special folder names such as sent and draft.

Check these are mapped to your imap folder names. They typical show as example Draft folder = Automatic (drafts)

If they are mapped to "none", tap and select the corresponding Imap folder name. See the screen shot below.

Then navigate back to manage folders Tap the three dot menu > refresh folder list. If missing folders appear, tap each and confirm "Show folder" is enabled.

Hopefully that helps.
